data.name: Baldev
data.gender_notes: Baldev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Baldev is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Bal’ meaning strength and ‘Dev’ meaning God. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted as Baldev or Balarama, the brother of Lord Krishna. Baldev signifies strength, courage, and protection. The name Baldev carries the meaning “Strong as a Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baldev usually hope their child will grow to embody strong as a mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of strength and divine grace.
data.etymology: Baldev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong as a Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baldev total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
